newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume increases on lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume increases on lower prices.

text.p: Volume rose on the Istanbul gold exchange to 719 kilos on Thursday from 310 kilos on Wednesday, as prices fell in line with world market trends, dealers said.
Gold prices eased to $378.80 an ounce from $380 and in lira terms to 1,213,400 lira per gram from 1,215,500 on Wednesday.
"The trade was mostly between banks with little real free market demand," one free market dealer said.
The first session saw 224 kilos of gold change hands and the second 495 kilos after the price drop. 94 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
